findings.claim: Cencora 2026-01 簽訂定期貸款，為收購其尚未持有的 OneOncology 多數股權融資；交易於 2026-02-02 生效（持股約由 35% 升至 92%，聚合來源）。
findings.excerpt: in connection with the previously announced proposed acquisition (the “Acquisition”) of the majority of the outstanding equity interests that the Company does not currently own in OneOncology.

findings.claim: 2026-05-06 公司下修財測後股價單日跌 17.3%，Rosen、Pomerantz 等律所宣布調查潛在證券詐欺請求（調查公告，非已提起之集體訴訟）。
findings.source: Barchart／AccessNewswire：Rosen Law Firm、Pomerantz 調查公告

findings.claim: 鴉片類藥物訴訟：第三方付款人與醫院集體和解 2025 年生效／獲最終核准。
findings.excerpt: The settlement became effective on April 4, 2025.

findings.excerpt: in connection with the previously announced proposed acquisition (the “Acquisition”) of the majority of the outstanding equity interests that the Company does not currently own in OneOncology.
